title: christmas garlands
text: christmas garlands. I was not expecting 2 DIFFERENT garlands... but it's ok.  They are thin and sparse - but I wanted that - they do have tiny lights that YOU will need to wind into the the garland AND they are NOT timed as I had hoped. They take 2 AA batteries that you will need to provide. One garland is more holly and berries with red ornament balls  - the other garland is holly and berries with a few gold painted pine cones and a few pine sprigs - oh and red ball ornaments. I do wish the lights had been inter twined already AND that they were 6 hours on 18 off - there is an on and off switch.  The box that holds the batteries is a frosted/clear-ish box that is VERY brittle plastic - it immediately broke upon opening the case to place the batteries.  I am using a rubber band to keep the remaining piece of the cover for the battery box.
